prompt:
Employees in many organisations receive so many written messages each day that a large part of their working time is spent reading and replying to them.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: The essay should have two parts: problems first, then measures; both given equal weight
Problems: no uninterrupted time left for real work, important information getting lost in the volume, constant interruptions causing fatigue and mistakes, correspondence spilling beyond working hours

Measures: setting rules for who should be messaged and what should not be written at all, replacing some correspondence with short face-to-face conversations, setting aside fixed times of day for messages, and keeping shared records in one place instead of resending them to everyone repeatedly
Measures should be matched to problems; it should be clear which measure addresses which problem
It should be stated who is responsible for the measures (company policy or personal habit)
common_mistakes: Writing about the problems but brushing off the measures with only 'fewer messages should be sent'
Shifting the topic to the general harms of technology
Using the name of a real app or company
